Kamagi - Official Gameplay Trailer
Check out the exclusive gameplay trailer for KAMAGI, an upcoming single-player, third-person action game from Korean indie studio SODA Production. Reimagining Korean folk tales and creatures from traditional Korean folklore in a modern setting, KAMAGI features fast, precise parry-focused combat, challenging boss fights, and a distinctive visual style. "Kamagi" is an old Korean word for "crow." KAMAGI is in development for PC (Steam) and consoles, with a target release of March 2028.

text:
Giant Ojosama - Official Teaser Trailer (2027)
Check out the trailer for the upcoming anime, Giant Ojosama! The series is coming January 2027 to HIDIVE.
Oriko Fujido, heiress of Fujido Zaibatsu, the world’s largest beverage and vending machine company, was given a town as a present for her 4th birthday. Ever since, Oriko has worked hard to help the town grow with the help of her butler and researcher, Dr. Sebastian. Now, a little over 10 years later, the town is suddenly invaded by an enormous kaiju and the ever boastful Oriko declares she must protect it! To aid her, Dr Sebastian creates an experimental energy drink. Upon drinking it, Oriko grows almost instantly into a skyscraper-sized giant. However, in her zeal to protect the town and battle the kaiju invader, Oriko also unintentionally creates havoc!

3 Body Problem - Official Season 2 Teaser Trailer
Don't miss the Season 2 Teaser Trailer for 3 Body Problem, the hit sci-fi action series distributed by Netflix. What's been watching comes to light in Season 2 of 3 Body Problem, streaming on January 14, 2027, on Netflix.

As the alien invasion nears, humanity prepares to meet them — on Earth and beyond.  While a space fleet embarks on a mission that spans centuries, a secret locked inside of one man's mind might be humanity's only hope for survival.

3 Body Problem stars Jess Hong, Benedict Wong, Eiza Gonzalez, Jovan Adepo, Saamer Usmani, Liam Cunningham, Marlo Kelly, Sea Shimooka, Claudia Doumit, Ellie De Lange, and more. The series is directed by Jeremy Podeswa (201, 202, 203), Miguel Sapochnik (204, 205, 206), and is written by David Benioff, D.B. Weiss, Alexander Woo (201), Rose Cartwright (202), Alexander Woo (203), Nichelle Tramble Spellman (204), David Benioff & D.B. Weiss (205, 206).

Season 2 of 3 Body Problem is streaming on January 14, 2027, on Netflix.

author: IGN YouTube
text:
GTA 6's Lucia Actress Confirmed — And It's Who You Think It Is - IGN Daily Fix
In today's Daily Fix:
Rockstar went to great lengths to hide the identities of the dual protagonists of GTA 6, but that didn't stop rumors from hitting the internet. One of the names tossed around for Lucia was Manni L. Perez, and it turns out the internet was right. The Game Awards revealed their list of nominees and Perez was nominated for Best Performance. The actor playing Jason, however, is still a mystery. And speaking of, GTA 6 leads in The Game Awards nominations, including Game of the Year. And finally, Sony has fought off a $2.6 billion lawsuit claiming they hold a 'near monopoly' through their PlayStation Store.
